name: lift-regression-type-and-unit
cmd: set -euo pipefail; OUT="$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR"; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; set +e; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/lift-regression.tsconfig.json > "$OUT/types.log" 2>&1; T=$?; bun test research/bapa/lift-regression.test.ts > "$OUT/tests.log" 2>&1; U=$?; printf "types=%s tests=%s\n" "$T" "$U" > "$OUT/checks.txt"; test "$T$U" = 00
